name_server_ip.description: IP address of the DNS nameserver to update

ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for the DNS challenge record

wait.description: Seconds to wait before verifying the challenge is served

verbosity.description: Verbosity level (negative values suppress more output)

key_name.description: TSIG key name for DNS update authentication

key_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for the TSIG key (e.g., hmac-md5, hmac-sha256)

dns_rewrite.description: Perl-style regex for rewriting DNS record names (e.g., redirecting to dynamic zone)

post_deploy_cert.description: Path to optional hook script run after certificate deployment
